$comment: Anti-reimplementation ratchet baseline (ADR-0022). Count of apps/api source files importing raw infrastructure drivers (pg, ws, ioredis) or hosting an HTTP server (createServer). ffmpeg-static/ffprobe-static are sanctioned binary-path providers injected into the framework MediaProcessor (slice 4) and @aws-sdk is loaded lazily by the framework S3 driver (ADR-0023), so neither is counted. The strangler-fig migration lowers this toward 0 as each hand-rolled adapter is replaced by a published StreetJS package. NEVER raise it. Remaining: realtime-bus.ts (ioredis) + realtime-hub.ts (ws), targeted by slice 6 (@streetjs/realtime).
